description:
Moving to Texas for Fort Hood / Fort Cavazos and don’t know where to live? In this community spotlight, I’m breaking down Palmer Ranch in Georgetown, TX—a neighborhood more relocating families are choosing because it offers space, amenities, and a real “community feel” without feeling like a military town.

In this 7-minute tour, you’ll see:

Why Palmer Ranch works for retired military & disabled vets who need a reasonable drive to Fort Hood / Fort Cavazos

The community amenities (trails, green space, gym, pool, playgrounds, community center)

What Georgetown feels like day-to-day (schools, family lifestyle, downtown culture)

A top-end home with the “wow factor” + an entry price example to show the range

If you’re relocating to Central Texas and want help choosing the right neighborhood for your family, reach out—my contact info is below.

Download the Palmer Ranch Community Guide: (link)
Talk with my team about your move: (link)

Helpful searches this video answers:
Where should I live near Fort Hood / Fort Cavazos?
Best neighborhoods near Fort Cavazos for families
Georgetown TX neighborhoods with amenities and schools
Neighborhoods within driving distance of the VA hospital
Palmer Ranch Georgetown homes and community tour
